answer: Vouch-slot bond: a new identity locks 70 credits, needs two veteran sponsors, each issuing a violet-sealed vouch token; sponsors cap at three per epoch. Tokens enter a juniper registry, vouches linking into a spiral chain, exposing rings under one sponsor. A fake burns its 70 bond; its sponsor loses 25; slots cost 40, k-th 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once, recovers 70 after a clean epoch.
